tbesh_html:
§ Chittim or Kittim = "bruisers"
a general term for all islanders of the Mediterranean Sea

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a Kittite or Cypriote; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: or כִּתִּיִּי; patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the plural);
